steps.content: Be it the myths from Eastia or the technology DisCity takes pride in, these are all stories of repeated victories over calamities, or miracles of humanity's ability to flourish again in the apocalypse.
It's the history of all the humans who overcome the impossible. Everything is set in stone now.
Sinners who were affected by the shackles and suffering from the Mania fever all recover. The aftermath of the Tide of Ashes in the city is quickly cleaned up.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Urgh... The fever these past few days felt like a dream. Ah! The shackles were burning hot... Did something happen to little clapper?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I heard from the folks at Drifter Camp that I missed out on a lot of exciting things.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Yes, My Best Cool Car's little clapper got a job behind our backs. Went to shoot some exotic epic fantasy film.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Despite some hitches, it probably wrapped up smoothly in the end.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What? He went behind OwO's back and shot an epic film?! No way! He can't possibly make anything good without My Best Cool Car's great director!
steps.female_content: What? She went behind OwO's back and shot an epic film?! No way! She can't possibly make anything good without My Best Cool Car's great director!

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Haha, he'll have plenty of help from the rest of the crew.
steps.female_content: Haha, she'll have plenty of help from the rest of the crew.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph... Fine, congratulations, I guess...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph! But it surely can't beat OwO's amazing film! I'll catch him next time and show him what a true masterpiece looks like!
steps.female_content: Hmph! But it surely can't beat OwO's amazing film! I'll catch her next time and show her what a true masterpiece looks like!

steps.content: With the Sun Crow's fall, the Three Calamities ended, and the bow's materials soon fell apart with the last Sun Shot Bow. However, the data collected in the process has been well preserved and remains invaluable research material.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I did it... Although it wasn't Yanyan who performed the Sun Shot, the ten suns didn't return, and the Sun Crow was defeated!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Great Seer! Grandma! Yanyan did it! We didn't let everyone down, I, ah, achoo!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Did you catch a cold after the temperature fell back down? If you require medical care...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: No, no. Don't worry about me, Adjutant Nightingale. I'm fine, really.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is everything okay in the city? Uncle Greta at the Drifter Camp and the old men at the Rust, are they all safe now? It was such a huge disaster. I'm really worried about them.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Damage assessment is still ongoing. But for now, everything is fine.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If you're so worried, why not head back to the Bureau and give them a call?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: ...Thank you for your assistance these past few days.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Don't mention it. You helped save DisCity. And given your physique, I imagine it was indeed not easy for you to travel all the way here.

The Eastian Alliance and DisCity have resumed discussions to evaluate various details in the Sun Crow Apostle operation. Their relations remain tense, with both sides sticking to their guns on technical intelligence security issues.

Despite that, communication channels have been established. Trade and shipping are gradually resuming, and exchanges between Eastians and DisCitizens are thriving. The public is optimistic about the future development between the two states.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Alright. The Eastian sorcery is indeed powerful. Thanks to you, the FAC saved not just Hypercubes, but also many precious lives of our soldiers. I owe you my thanks.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: No, it's me who should be grateful. Thank you for fighting hard to defeat the Sun Crow and fulfilling our long-held wish.
The leader in white armor extends his hand.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We're all victims of Mania. When you get a chance, come to DisCity again so we can exchange our experiences.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Certainly.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: They're too lenient with those Outland spies... Why would Paradeisos allow that Chief to act so recklessly? This will only complicate things.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Operative
steps.content: Because the one assessing the risks isn't you, it's the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Operative
steps.content: Rest assured, representative. We are the pros of monitoring suspicious individuals and eliminating threats to the city. If needed, we'll be watching you too...
He smiles and tips his hat to the representative before taking a step back into the darkness.
On the screen, you and Du Ruo are still being monitored.
The flames near the battlefield have died out, leaving only the lingering acrid smoke.
You and Du Ruo support each other, making your way through the rubble of the ruins.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Can... you still feel it?
On the other end of the shackles, the heat and madness have vanished. Finally, the long-missed peace is back.
But it makes you feel a bit melancholic.
She served as a container for the sealed Sun Crow for so long... but not a sliver of her consciousness was left behind...

The fierce battle also temporarily cleared the threats that used to roam the DisSea. Dragging your weary bodies, you trudge over the rubble, searching every piece of debris burnt by the Sun Crow with a faint hope. Finally, you reach the center of the battlefield.
It's a vast expanse of empty, scorched earth.
The Sun Crow didn't leave behind a single feather or any trace of remains.
Du Ruo bends down to feel the residual warmth of the earth left by the fire.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You're gone. Well, it's for the best... I don't even know how else to express my gratitude to you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Look, the sun is about to set.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The Great Seer's lie has come to the perfect end...
